Important Instructions :
Application fees paid to the National Biodiversity Authority will not be refunded under
any circumstances. Therefore, stakeholders are advised to file the correct forms as per their
eligibility and requirements through https://absefiline.nic.inAlBA/loein/auth.
It is hereby informed to all stakeholders that the name of the applicant provided in the
IPR-related forms submitted to the National Biodiversity Authority shall exactly match
the applicant's name as entered with the Intellectual Property Office.
For further clarification, stakeholders may refer to the Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act.
2023, the Biological Diversity (Amendment) Rules. 2024 and Regulation,2025.
(Dr. B. Balaji, t{ lryl6
Member Secretary, NBA,
Chennai
